entities.name: Uktabi Jungle
entities.description: A small jungle on Zhalfir, once part of Jamuraa, domain of the Quirion elves.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane the Uktabi now belongs to.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Set up diplomatic relations with the nations of Jamuraa; allied to the Quirion elves.

entities.name: Quirion elves
entities.description: Allies of Mangara who colonized much of the Uktabi.

entities.name: Salamzuri
entities.description: The Quirion elves' city, capital of the Uktabi and sanctuary for refugees.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: A war during which the jungle had a Maro-Sorcerer.

events.summary: Uktabi was phased out with the rest of Zhalfir and now exists as part of that separate plane.
events.quote: Uktabi was phased out with the rest of Zhalfir

relations.note: The Uktabi was the domain of his allies, the Quirion elves.
relations.quote: the Uktabi had been the domain of his allies, the Quirion elves

relations.note: It now exists as part of Zhalfir.
relations.quote: now exists as part of that separate plane
